description: One role pulls by in the middle and is courtesy turned by the dancer opposite.

walkthrough.line: {chains} pull by right hands in the middle, cross the set, and are turned by the lark there.
walkthrough.teach: {chains} pull by right hands in the middle, passing right shoulders, and carry on across the set. The lark you come to is already backing a small circle. Join it at the far side: your left hand in the lark's left, the lark's right hand on your own right hand behind your back. Walk forward as the lark walks backward, turning as one, and open out side by side.
